note: This file is a pure configuration file (MMSegmentation config) for the ADE20K dataset with 640x640 crop size. It contains only variable assignments — no functions, classes, or callable APIs. No example statements can be generated.
dataset_type: configuration variable: sets dataset type to 'ADE20KDataset'
data_root: configuration variable: sets data root path to 'data/ade/ADEChallengeData2016'
crop_size: configuration variable: sets crop size to (640, 640)
train_pipeline: configuration variable: defines training data augmentation pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, LoadAnnotations, RandomResize, RandomCrop, RandomFlip, PhotoMetricDistortion, PackSegInputs
test_pipeline: configuration variable: defines test data pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, LoadAnnotations, PackSegInputs
img_ratios: configuration variable: defines image resize ratios [0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75] for test-time augmentation
tta_pipeline: configuration variable: defines test-time augmentation pipeline with multi-scale Resize and RandomFlip transforms
train_dataloader: configuration variable: defines training dataloader with batch_size=4, InfiniteSampler, and ADE20K training dataset
val_dataloader: configuration variable: defines validation dataloader with batch_size=1, DefaultSampler, and ADE20K validation dataset
test_dataloader: configuration variable: references val_dataloader for test data loading
val_evaluator: configuration variable: defines validation evaluator using IoUMetric with mIoU metric
test_evaluator: configuration variable: references val_evaluator for test evaluation
